_comment: Set `active` (or the TRENDPULSE_VERTICAL env var) to go deep on one niche instead of a mile wide across 13 categories. A vertical narrows what is tracked and re-weights scoring for what actually predicts success in that niche.

all.label: All Categories
all.description: Every tracked category. Broadest coverage, shallowest expertise — hardest position to defend.

health-performance.label: Health & Performance
health-performance.description: Supplements, recovery, sleep and fitness gear. The largest coherent cluster already tracked (~293 keywords) and the category where community validation leads retail demand most reliably.

beauty-personal-care.label: Beauty & Personal Care
beauty-personal-care.description: Skincare, haircare and at-home devices. Short trend cycles, so momentum is weighted hard and crowding matters more than price.

home-outdoor.label: Home & Outdoor
home-outdoor.description: Kitchen, home goods and outdoor equipment. Higher ticket, slower cycles — margin and competition carry more weight than social buzz.
